flags.why: Using ngó to mean taking a peek is not specifically Northern usage.
The common noun meaning 'deposit', used in tiền cọc and mất cọc, is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-c%E1%BB%8Dc)).
flags.fix: noun | deposit (money paid in advance to secure a purchase, rental or booking)

flags.why: The literal river-crossing sense is dated rather than ordinary present-day usage ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-qu%C3%A1%20giang)).
Bê is not a conventional Vietnamese representation of a calf's cry; be is the word representing a goat's bleat ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/be-erUT3AUS6h2E8.html)).
flags.fix: Delete this sense and its example.

flags.why: This figurative use is current colloquial Vietnamese, commonly occurring in bê nguyên and bê nguyên xi, rather than rare ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%C3%AA)).
